declared: before any capture of campaign v2 exists; this file's git commit and sha256 are the declaration
comparison: per comparison: the reference set's Geant4 captures against the candidate (the bank of A2 replayed at the reference's entrance states in its placement, in float64 and float32; or, for null_g4, another Geant4 set), in the global frame, per class (incoming species and kinetic energy)
binning_note: [lo, hi, n]: n equal bins between lo and hi plus an underflow and an overflow bin. Edges are kept off the values a straight-through particle takes exactly: the module's faces (+-200, +-30, +-110 mm), the direction cosines 0 and +-1, and the incoming kinetic energies (v1 had edges there; see README)

criteria.name: shapes
criteria.note: cluster-robust Hotelling T^2 p-value, Bonferroni over every tested (class, observable) of the comparison

criteria.name: mean_edep
criteria.observable: mean total deposit per trial, worst class
criteria.note: candidate / reference with the cluster-robust error of the class furthest from 1 in errors

pass: every criterion for every comparison and both replay dtypes (null_g4 has no replay: its one result counts for both); null_g4 and B2 are the nulls of the test and of the procedure and must pass like the others

comparisons.name: null_g4
comparisons.note: Geant4 vs Geant4 at the nominal placement: the false-failure rate of the test itself, no replay

statistic: per (class, observable): Hotelling T^2 of the difference of per-trial rate vectors over the bins with at least min_bin_entries entries on both sides, with cluster-robust covariances (a Geant4 trial is one cluster; replayed trials that drew the same bank trial are one cluster), p from chi2 with k = rank of the summed covariance; mean deposit ratio per class with cluster-robust errors
